Culture / Hospitality / Godenggre, Meghalaya

Godenggre Brewery & Experience Centre

A visitor programme near the Wangala festival grounds explores local brewing traditions through production, tasting and an experience gallery. A beer café, connecting bridges and public roof space are considered within the landscape.
